example.romanization: ngài thùng thùng-sṳ yit-ha hi sṳt-fan.
example.english: I go eat with my coworkers.

note: 同事 is used just like in Mandarin, but the Hakka reading is thùng-sṳ with the Sixian rising-less low tone on 同. Colleagues often share lunch boxes and chat in Hakka at farms, factories and shops, so the word comes up constantly in daily life.
